# SmolWAM: Transforming the Video World Action Model into a Lightweight Control Interface

**SmolWAM (A Latent World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices)** is distilled from Cosmos Policy 2B with approximately 0.88B parameters. In a single forward pass, it predicts 16 robot actions and the dual-camera visual latent representation 16 steps later simultaneously. The authors report that it achieved 382 out of 400 rounds (95.5%) in LIBERO; each action block on A100 takes 57 ms, approximately 11 times faster than the teacher setting.[ Paper abstract and Table 1 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S4)

This chapter focuses on a specific issue: given pre-trained video weights, how can we preserve their control and future prediction capabilities while eliminating the overhead caused by the video generation interface? It is necessary to understand Transformers, VAEs, and action blocks before reading this. You can first read [ embodied AI reasoning and deployment framework ](../09-embodied-ai-reasoning-and-deployment-framework/README.md) to grasp the division of labor between model inference and action execution.

This chapter is written based on the public paper and official code dated 2026-10-24. It serves as an entry for method interpretation and practice. The performance figures below are from the author's experiments, and this repository has not yet run SmolWAM inference or re-evaluated LIBERO.

![Comparison of the official inference architectures of Cosmos Policy and SmolWAM: single-frame encoding, cached text, 12-layer backbone, single-step action, and future reading ](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/12SmolWAM轻量世界动作模型/assets/architecture.svg)

Figure 1: The upper part shows the video generation interface for the teacher, while the lower part displays the lightweight control interface of SmolWAM. You can refer to the figure to observe the changes in visual encoding, text, Transformer depth, and reading steps. Source: [ Official architecture diagram of SmolWAM ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/assets/architecture.svg), with the original figure retained. The teacher's computing power in the figure uses 31.0 TFLOP from the official repository; the results table in this chapter uses 42.6 TFLOP from paper v1. For differences in scale, see Section 4.

## 1. Understand the source of costs from video to layout generation

The LIBERO interface of Cosmos Policy places different types of data into the same potential frame sequence. Each frame is first represented as a potential tensor of `16 × 28 × 28`, and then divided into `14 × 14 = 196` tokens; action, state, and value vectors also fill up one frame by repeating the filling process.

```text
教师：9 帧 × 196 = 1764 个令牌
条件：空白帧 | 当前状态 | 当前腕部图像 | 当前外部图像
生成：动作块 | 未来状态 | 未来腕部图像 | 未来外部图像 | 价值

学生：5 帧 × 196 + 28 = 1008 个令牌
条件：空白帧 | 当前腕部图像 | 当前外部图像
生成：28 个状态条件动作查询 | 未来腕部图像 | 未来外部图像
```

The figure lists the retained slots; in practice, the original token positions of the teacher are used. The current state is injected into the action query, while the future state frames and value frames are removed. Two future camera frames participate in the same prediction, forming the world head. [ paper §3.1–3.2 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S3), [ official layout implementation ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/smolwam/layout.py)

![ Teacher 1764 tokens and SmolWAM 1008 tokens official layout diagram, indicating the removal of status and value frames, as well as 28 action queries ](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/12SmolWAM轻量世界动作模型/assets/tokens.svg)

Figure 2: Students retain blank frames, current and future dual-camera frames, and replace action frames with 28 state condition queries; the horizontal width corresponds to the number of tokens. Source: [SmolWAM official token layout diagram ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/assets/tokens.svg), with the original image retained.

The teacher would originally perform VAE encoding on 33 frame segments, use a T5-XXL text encoder with 4.8B parameters, and apply 28-layer Transformer with 5-step denoising to 1764 tokens. SmolWAM retains the pre-trained backbone weights, token positions, and rectified stream reading, and reconstructs the interface item by item based on visual, textual, depth, action, and sampling steps.

## 2. Five changes, and why they need distillation

### 2.1 Single-frame encoding: Reconnecting to the teacher's potential space via an adapter

Each camera image is encoded once by the Wan2.1 encoder with approximately 54M parameters, and then mapped to the teacher's desired segment pattern potential space using an adapter with approximately 0.5M parameters.

Single-frame encoding is not inherently equivalent to segment encoding. The paper measures the normalized L1 error of single-step action blocks relative to demonstration: the original value is **0.0089**, directly switching to single-frame becomes **0.038**, and adding an adapter restores it to **0.0092**. The adapter here serves for aligning the input distribution, rather than relearning the entire visual representation. [ paper §3.2 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S3.S2)

### 2.2 Cache BERT: 512 positions contain useful attention weights

SmolWAM replaces T5-XXL with BERT-base instruction features, projects them onto the context width of the backbone, and fills zeros up to **512 positions**. The official release package caches the LIBERO instruction; new instructions will call BERT encoding as needed. There are also six zero-initialized vision-to-language layers, allowing the instruction features to focus on images.

Why does the zero-padding length affect the action? The key for cross-attention and the value projection have no bias, so the zero-padding positions result in zero key and zero value. For a query, let the attention logit of valid words be \(\ell_i\), and there be \(m\) zero-padding positions, then the attention output is:

$$
o=\frac{\sum_i \exp(\ell_i)v_i}{\sum_i\exp(\ell_i)+m}.
$$

The value at the zero-padding position is zero, but each `exp(0)=1` remains in the softmax denominator to absorb the attention quality. Directly truncating these positions would change the weights of the valid words. **These zero positions must participate in the attention normalization; excluding them would also alter the original calculation.**

When the author cuts the teacher text context into 32 or 128 positions, each closed loop diagnosis drops to **0/5** success; after restoring the removed softmax quality, it returns to **5/5**, and the difference from the original zero-padding attention value is approximately `6e-8`. This explains why "deleting empty positions" still damages the pre-trained interface. [ paper §3.2 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S3.S2)

### 2.3 Preserve the boundary layer: The near-identity layer cannot be arbitrarily grouped and deleted

The author uses the block influence degree \(1-\cos(h_{in},h_{out})\) to measure the change in layer representation. The 0th, 1st, and 25–27th layers have the greatest impact, while the 3–22th layers are nearly identity mappings when considered individually.

However, "small changes in a single layer" does not directly imply "no impact from combined removal". Zero-sample diagnostics for 5 rounds per group show that skipping the 1st, 26th, or 27th layer individually results in 0/5; skipping the 7th, 14th, or 20th layer individually results in 5/5; skipping both the 12th and 15th layers together results in 0/5.

Finally, students will retain **0–2 and 19–27, totaling 12 layers**, and inherit the corresponding teacher weights for distillation. Section 3.2 of the paper states that the size of the retained layers is approximately **0.85B**; Table 1 and the official experimental records report a student network size of approximately **0.88B** (the exact value is about 0.878B). Parameter statistics do not include VAE and text encoders. These two figures should be understood separately.[Paper §3.2, Table 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S3.S2)、[Official experimental instructions](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/experiments/README.md)

### 2.4 Status Condition Action Query: Integrate status into 28 queries

Zero initialization MLP adds the robot state to 28 action queries, replacing the original action frames that used 196 tokens. The queries follow the same positions as the teacher action slots.

The author first diagnoses which layouts in the teacher can be directly modified:

| Zero-sample layout changes | Relative normalized L1 action |
| --- | ---: |
| Original layout | Approximately 0.009 |
| Removal of future state and value frames | No more than 0.019 |
| Removal of blank frames | 0.30 |
| Removal of current state frames | 0.058 |
| Compressing vector frames to 28 tokens | 0.21 |

Finally, students retain the blank frames, rejoin the current state through status condition queries, and train a compact layout. **The diagnostic results that directly delete the status frames are different from those of final students who have learned status injection. These are two distinct experiments.** The calculation for 1008 tokens is: 196 blank frames, 392 current dual cameras, 392 future dual cameras, plus 28 action queries. [ Paper §3.2 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S3.S2)

### 2.5 Single-step rectified current: Reading actions and future from the same clean estimate

The rectified current interpolates clean data and noise, and predicts speed:

$$
x_\tau=(1-\tau)x_0+\tau\epsilon,\qquad
v_\theta(x_\tau,\tau)\approx\epsilon-x_0.
$$

The clean estimate is obtained as follows:

$$
\hat{x}_0=x_\tau-\tau v_\theta(x_\tau,\tau).
$$

SmolWAM uses fixed noise at the maximum noise level \(\sigma=80\) and \(\tau=80/81\approx0.988\), runs the主干 only once, and reads the action blocks and future potential representations from \(\hat{x}_0\) respectively. Actions and the future are generated jointly; the actions do not wait for a denoised future to be available as a conditional input.

The world head is supervised during training; conventional control reasoning retains potential predictions without RGB decoding. The official API also provides `return_future=True` and `decode_future(...)` for visualizing future predictions. [ paper §3.1–3.2 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S3), [ official policy API ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/smolwam/policy.py)

## 3. Layout Course: Restore pruning first, then learn compression

Students are initialized from the retained teacher layer. During the **1000 steps** before training, the 1764 token layout of the teacher is still used, and then it switches to the 1008 token layout, totaling **5000 steps**. This sequence processes the depth pruning and layout compression distribution changes in stages.

The data comes from 1,700 successful LIBERO demonstrations published by Cosmos Policy. 68,830 observations were obtained by sampling every four steps. Teachers generate single-step actions and future potential representations under a fixed noise, which are pre-cached as distillation targets.

Let the demonstration action and the potential real future representation be \(a,z\), and the teacher prediction be \(a^{\mathcal T},z^{\mathcal T}\). The main loss is:

$$
\mathcal L=\|\hat a-a\|_1+\|\hat a-a^{\mathcal T}\|_1
+\|\hat z-z\|_1+\|\hat z-z^{\mathcal T}\|_1.
$$

When the status frame and value frame are present, an additional loss of 0.1 weight is added. Training uses AdamW, batch size 32, bf16; the inheritance weight learning rate is `2e-5`, and the new weight is `1e-4`. The paper report is trained on an A100 for approximately **3.6 hours**; the official complete pipeline includes about **5 hours** of preparation steps, and the teacher target cache takes about **66 minutes**. [ Paper §3.3 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S3.S3), [ Official training entry point ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/experiments/train_smolwam.sh)

## 4. Results: Where is the efficiency improvement, and what have the world leaders learned?

The following table uses the statistics from Table 1 of paper v1. The processing time refers to the time required for a 16-step action block to be observed, under A100-SXM4-40GB, batch 1, and bf16, including preprocessing and VAE encoding. The text features of each model are cached. TFLOP includes the network and VAE encoder.

| Model | Network Parameters | TFLOP/block | ms/block | Peak VRAM GiB | Success Rate in 60 Rounds | Success Rate in 400 Rounds |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cosmos Policy, 5 steps | 1.96B | 42.6 | 624 | 7.55 | 96.7% | 98.2% |
| Teacher, single frame + adapter, 1 step | 1.96B | 7.52 | 126 | 4.39 | 100.0% | — |
| SmolWAM, 1 step | 0.88B | 2.30 | 57 | 2.36 | 93.3% | 95.5% |

1. The results of the teacher's 400 rounds are from the author's earlier L4 evaluation pipeline. The original Cosmos Policy paper report was 98.5%; here, 98.2% is used as a reference according to the SmolWAM paper. In the official README, the result table indicates 31.0 TFLOP for the teacher's computing power, which does not match 42.6 in Table 1 and the abstract of the paper. Therefore, the **18.5-fold decrease in computing power** in this chapter is expressed using `42.6 / 2.30`, and these two values are not mixed together. [ Table 1 of the paper ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S4), [ official repository ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM)

By changing the teacher to a single frame and single step, the time required is reduced from 624 ms to 126 ms; the number of layers and layout of students are further reduced to 57 ms. This supports the core conclusion of the paper: the video interface itself accounts for a large portion of the control and reasoning costs.

The four complete evaluation suites are Spatial **99%**, Object **100%**, Goal **94%**, and Long **89%**. The efficiency gain retains approximately 97% of the teacher's success rate, with the difference mainly occurring in multi-step tasks. 57 ms corresponds to approximately 17.7 action block queries per second; the total of 282 actions per second, obtained by multiplying 16 actions per block, is the generation throughput, and the feedback response frequency depends on action block execution and query scheduling.

The world head maintains the Markdown structure, indentation, lists, tables, and line breaks in 96 contexts. Compared to directly copying the current frame, the potential future L1 is reduced from **0.133 to 0.101**, and the optical flow endpoint error is decreased from **1.63 to 1.43 pixels**. The LPIPS of the decoded image is 0.128, while copying the current frame results in 0.115. It retains motion prediction capability, but the image texture remains blurred. The control evidence currently comes from LIBERO; official data also show an operation time of approximately 0.9 seconds/block on M2 Pro. [ paper §4 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S4)

Figure 3: From left to right are **current scene, predicting the future, and real future**. The prediction captures the future position of the robotic arm, with blurred visual details; this image is decoded for display, while the conventional control path retains the potential future representation directly. Source: [SmolWAM Figure 2](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S4.F2), [ Original images by the authors](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/paper/figs/world_head_forecast.png).

## 5. Compare the code to understand input and output

The official code supports CUDA, Apple MPS, and CPU exclusively through PyTorch. It is recommended to run the quickstart with the observations provided by the repository first, then perform a single round of LIBERO, and finally execute the full protocol. Below is a sample call for the official interface that has been verified:

```python
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from smolwam import SmolWAM

# 从官方 SmolWAM 仓库根目录运行；使用已预取的发布目录。
sample = Path("examples/sample_obs")
meta = json.loads((sample / "obs.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
obs = {
    "primary_image": np.asarray(Image.open(sample / "primary.png").convert("RGB")),
    "wrist_image": np.asarray(Image.open(sample / "wrist.png").convert("RGB")),
    "proprio": np.asarray(meta["proprio"], dtype=np.float32),
}
policy = SmolWAM.from_pretrained("/path/to/local/smolwam-release")
actions, future = policy.predict_action(obs, meta["instruction"], return_future=True)
print(actions.shape)       # (16, 7)：末端位姿增量 6 维 + 夹爪命令 1 维
print(tuple(future.shape)) # (2, 16, 28, 28)：双相机潜在表示
print(policy.last_timing)  # 首次查询含预热；测速应重复调用
frames = policy.decode_future(future)  # 仅在需要展示未来画面时调用
```

The second dimension of `future` is 16, representing the potential channels; the time objective involves two camera images in step 16 in the future, not 16 frames of video. `proprio` has 9 dimensions, including the positions of two gripper joints, the three-dimensional end position, and four quadruples. The images should be positive RGB; when using LIBERO raw observations, the rendering flip is handled by the official `policy_observation`. [ official example ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/examples/quickstart.py), [ policy implementation ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/smolwam/policy.py)

The deployment weight is in [ Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/timiiowolabi/SmolWAM). The official description indicates that preparing the model with Wan2.1 VAE first requires approximately 4 GB of space. **For models, dependencies, and data prefetching on this machine, moon, and Ubuntu, use the project's "Conscience Cloud Download专线"**. The entry point for this machine is `C:\Users\kewei\Documents\2026\07重要学术项目\15wifi扩展\LabDownload.cmd`. First, complete the dependency installation and resource prefetching through the entry point, then reuse the cache to run inference, training, or evaluation. If only the local model path is provided, a VAE configuration reference is still required; for commands outside the cache, BERT resources are needed. Do not include the entire evaluation program in the download专线.

### Official Reproduction Entry and Reading Order

| Learning Objectives | Official Entry | Contents to Observe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Single Inference | `examples/quickstart.py` | `(16, 7)` action block, time after preheating |
| Understanding 1008 Tokens | `smolwam/layout.py`, `smolwam/model.py` | Slot reservation, state injection, original position and single-step reading |
| Connecting to Closed Loop Environment | `smolwam/envs/libero.py`, `smolwam/eval_libero.py` | Image orientation, 9-dimensional state, action block execution |
| Reproduction Success Rate | `experiments/eval_libero.sh full` | 40 tasks × 10 rounds, seed 195, 16-step full execution |
| Reproduction Efficiency | `experiments/bench.sh` | Parameters, tokens, FLOPs, time and memory usage on non-contending devices |
| Checking Future Prediction | `experiments/world_eval.sh` | Comparing the potential errors and motion metrics of copying the current frame |
| Redoing Distillation | `experiments/train_smolwam.sh` | Potential library → Adapter → Text cache → Teacher target → Training → Export |

For the commands, expected output, and environment of the script, refer to the [ official experimental instructions ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM/blob/dde1e5bfe35c439499343c6d70e9cd32c96d0b36/experiments/README.md). The full evaluation will run four suites concurrently; the time comparison should be measured using an idle device. Teacher diagnosis revealed that executing only 8 steps instead of the original 16-step block would cause the filtering task to fail entirely, so the entire block execution protocol should be retained during reproduction. [ Paper §4 ](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13740v1#S4)

Another implementation detail is the RoPE space extrapolation coefficient of **3.0**, and frame-rate modulation is turned off. The official documentation states that if the default value of the library is misused during the reconstruction of the backbone, the weights will load properly, but the motion error will increase from approximately 0.009 to 0.40. These configurations should be checked together when reading or adapting `smolwam/nn/dit.py`. The official method description for [ is ](https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM#method)

## 6. Connect with the deployment framework section

The main benefits of SmolWAM lie in the model structure and input-output interfaces: single-frame adaptation, retention of attention sum, boundary layer pruning, state condition query, and single-step action and future joint reading. It provides a lightweight WAM example for the [ inference and deployment framework ](../09-embodied-ai-reasoning-and-deployment-framework/README.md); runtime optimization and robot execution scheduling can be further developed based on this model interface.

After reading, you can continue to analyze the three specific issues: Which normalization calculation is affected by the zero-filling positions? Why cannot the effects of near-identity layers be added directly? Why must the deletion of state frames be understood together with the learning of action queries? These three issues correspond to the attention, depth, and layout diagnostics in this chapter respectively.
